concerns.text: The plan’s Phase 0 checks for a column named `permeability` in the listed verified datasets, but none of the cited datasets actually contain an experimental permeability column (or any approved surrogate). Consequently the pipeline will always halt and open a GitHub issue, violating FR‑001 which requires the system to acquire at least one public dataset with a valid permeability target (or an approved surrogate). Without an appropriate target dataset the research question cannot be answered.
